issues.description: Critical logic bug: The condition 'if(db) db;' is a no-op statement that has no effect. This should return early if database is already initialized to prevent re-initialization, which could cause data loss or corruption.
issues.suggestion: Change line 7 to 'if(db) return;' or 'if(db) return db;' to properly implement singleton pattern and prevent reinitialization

issues.description: Potential null reference error in addTodo(): Function assumes db is initialized and directly calls methods on it without null checks. If called before initDb(), will throw runtime error.
issues.suggestion: Add null check at beginning: if (!db) { throw new Error('Database not initialized. Call initDb() first.'); }

issues.description: Using @ts-ignore to suppress TypeScript errors defeats the purpose of TypeScript. This could hide type-related bugs and makes code harder to maintain.
issues.suggestion: Install proper type definitions for neverchange or create custom type definition file (neverchange.d.ts) to properly type the library

issues.description: Database instance uses 'any' type which eliminates type safety. This can lead to runtime errors that TypeScript should catch at compile time.
issues.suggestion: Define proper interface for NeverChangeDB: let db: NeverChangeDBInstance | null = null; where NeverChangeDBInstance has execute(), query(), addMigrations(), init() methods

issues.description: Inconsistent error handling: toggleTodo() has no try-catch block while addTodo, updateTodo, and deleteTodo do. Creates unpredictable error behavior.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent error handling to all functions or remove from individual functions and let errors propagate to caller for centralized handling

issues.description: Code uses parameterized queries but without type definitions or documentation for neverchange library, cannot verify it properly sanitizes parameters. The @ts-ignore suggests library may not be well-maintained.
issues.suggestion: Verify neverchange library properly handles parameterized queries, add input validation for text parameter (max length, non-empty check), consider using more established database library

issues.description: Functions accepting user input (text, id) don't validate input. Text could be empty or excessively long, id could be negative or non-integer.
issues.suggestion: Add input validation: check text is non-empty and under max length, verify id is positive integer

issues.description: Console.error statements log full error object which may expose database structure, SQL queries, or other sensitive information in production logs.
issues.suggestion: In production, log errors at more abstract level and use structured logging library that can filter sensitive information

issues.description: Console.log statements in production code create noise in logs and should be replaced with proper logging infrastructure.
issues.suggestion: Use proper logging library (winston, pino) with configurable log levels for production environments

issues.description: Inconsistent formatting: missing space in 'if(db)', inconsistent line breaks in function calls throughout file.
issues.suggestion: Use code formatter like Prettier to ensure consistent code style

issues.description: Functions don't have explicit return type annotations, relying on TypeScript's type inference. Reduces code clarity and can hide type errors.
issues.suggestion: Add explicit return types: export async function initDb(): Promise<void>, export async function getTodos(): Promise<Todo[]>, etc.

codeQuality.summary: Code has critical logic bug in initDb() preventing proper initialization guard. Multiple functions lack null checks before using db, risking crashes. Type safety completely compromised with @ts-ignore and 'any' types. Error handling inconsistent. No input validation. The refactoring to neverchange simplifies code but introduces serious reliability and maintainability issues that must be addressed before merging.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Database initialization and migrations are critical infrastructure. Failure here breaks entire application. The bug in line 7 would be caught by tests. No tests verify migrations run correctly or handle failures.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test that initDb() can be called multiple times safely without re-initialization. Test migration version 1 creates todos table with correct schema. Test migration version 2 adds deleted column. Test migration failures are handled gracefully.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Core CRUD operation with error handling that's never tested. Try-catch block is untested. Console.log makes testing difficult. No verification of successful insertion.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test successful todo insertion. Test with empty/null text. Test SQL parameter binding prevents injection. Test error handling when database fails. Test special characters and very long text.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical read operation with fallback to empty array (|| []). No tests verify filtering of deleted todos, ordering by id DESC, or null handling works correctly.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test returns empty array when no todos. Test returns only non-deleted todos. Test correct DESC ordering by id. Test null result handling from db.query. Test multiple todos returned correctly.

untestedPaths.reasoning: State mutation with NO error handling. Fails silently on invalid IDs. Boolean toggle logic (NOT completed) needs verification. Missing try-catch unlike other functions.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test toggling from false to true and back. Test with non-existent id. Test with invalid id types (null, string). Test only specified todo is affected, not others.

untestedPaths.reasoning: CRUD operation with error handling and re-throwing. No tests verify error propagation works or that updates succeed. Parameter binding untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test successful text update. Test with empty text. Test with special characters. Test error thrown for non-existent id. Test database errors propagate correctly. Test other todos unaffected.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Soft delete implementation (sets deleted=1) is never tested. Critical to verify it doesn't permanently delete data and that getTodos() properly filters deleted items.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test todo marked as deleted (not removed from database). Test deleted todos don't appear in getTodos(). Test with non-existent id. Test deleting already deleted todo. Test error propagation.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No function checks if db is initialized before use. Combined with bug in line 7, could cause null reference errors if any function called before initDb().
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test calling each function (addTodo, getTodos, toggleTodo, updateTodo, deleteTodo) before initDb() is called to ensure proper error handling or automatic initialization.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Database migrations are critical infrastructure. Need testing to ensure they run in order, are idempotent, and handle upgrade scenarios correctly.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test migrations run in order (v1 then v2). Test migration idempotency (running twice doesn't break). Test upgrading from v1 to v2 schema. Test new database gets both migrations.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No validation for null, undefined, wrong types, or boundary values in any function. Could cause unexpected behavior or crashes.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test null/undefined text in addTodo. Test negative/zero/float id values. Test SQL injection attempts. Test extremely long text strings. Test boundary conditions.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for concurrent database operations which could expose race conditions in NeverChangeDB or the module-level db singleton.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test multiple simultaneous addTodo calls. Test simultaneous read and write operations. Test concurrent toggleTodo on same todo. Test race condition in initDb().

testCoverage.summary: Zero test coverage - no test files exist for this database module. All 6 exported functions are completely untested. Critical paths like initialization, migrations, and CRUD operations have 0% coverage. The critical bug in initDb() and missing null checks would be immediately caught by basic unit tests. No integration tests verify the complete CRUD workflow. No edge case testing for invalid inputs, concurrent operations, or error scenarios.

refactorings.summary: Critical refactoring needed: Fix initialization guard bug in initDb(), add null checks to all CRUD functions, remove @ts-ignore and implement proper TypeScript typing, add consistent error handling across all operations, extract migrations for maintainability, implement input validation. The migration to neverchange library simplifies code structure but current implementation has serious reliability issues.

recommendations.description: Fix the critical initialization guard bug in initDb() on line 7. Change 'if(db) db;' to 'if(db) return;' to prevent multiple database initializations that could cause data corruption.
Add database initialization checks to all CRUD functions (addTodo, getTodos, toggleTodo, updateTodo, deleteTodo) before using the db object to prevent null reference errors at runtime.

Create comprehensive unit test suite for all database operations. Current coverage is 0%. Priority tests: initDb() initialization and re-initialization, all CRUD operations, migration system, error handling paths, and edge cases.

Remove @ts-ignore directive and replace all 'any' types with proper TypeScript interfaces. Define interfaces for NeverChangeDB, Migration, and Todo to restore type safety and enable compile-time error detection.
Add consistent error handling to toggleTodo() function to match the try-catch pattern used in addTodo, updateTodo, and deleteTodo. Ensure all functions handle errors consistently.

Implement input validation for all user-supplied parameters. Validate text is non-empty and under reasonable length limit. Validate id is positive integer. This prevents invalid data from reaching database.
Extract migration definitions to a module-level constant or separate file to improve code organization, readability, and testability of the migration system.
Add integration tests to verify complete CRUD workflow and migration system upgrades. Test concurrent operations and race conditions in initialization.
Remove console.log statements from library code. Implement proper logging strategy that allows consumers to control logging behavior, or let errors propagate for centralized handling.
